title: hush_cut
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.12) — shape from hush-prd.md §7.1 hush_cut, FR-19, FR-20, FR-21, §8; not routed yet. CEP WNC_HUSH.cut (signed bridge). Mode Cut: QE razor on every ticked track at every cut boundary, remove the pieces inside the cuts, close the gaps in one pass, relink video with the audio under it (linkSelection). Backup first (clone the sequence as '<name> (Hush backup HH:MM:SS)', switch back, abort when the original cannot be made active); a locked ticked track aborts with nothing cut. Safety (verbatim, §8): never cut into speech, boundaries rounded inward to frames; backup before cutting; re-read track objects after every razor; gap closing in one pass; unticked tracks, locked tracks and media on disk untouched. UXP has no razor.
